item.title: 1 officer killed, 2nd injured in shooting near Indiana high school; suspect apprehended
item.description: One police officer was killed and another was injured in a shooting in Beech Grove, Indiana on Monday. The suspect was taken into custody Monday evening, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department.

item.title: 2 stabbed on Vandalia Road in Greensboro, police say
item.description: GREENSBORO, N.C. (WGHP) — Police are investigating a stabbing in Greensboro. According to the Greensboro Police Department, around 8:15 a.m. Monday morning, officers responded to Vandalia Road. At the scene they located two victims who had been stabbed. They were taken to the hospital. The investigation is ongoing and no further information was available.
